question: What solvent mixture, at what volume ratio, was used to extract the cubic lacustrine shale samples, and at what temperature and for how long?
expect: dichloromethane/methanol 93:7 (v/v), water bath at 40 °C for 14 days (fluid changed every 2-3 days) (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
Document: "Sequential Solvent Extraction Reveals Lithofacies-Dependent Pore Accessibility, Wettability, and Hydrocarbon Partitioning in Organic-Rich Lacustrine Shales"

The solvent mixture used to extract the cubic lacustrine shale samples was a dichloromethane/methanol mixture at a volume ratio of 93:7. 

The beaker was placed in a water bath at 40 °C for 14 days to remove the oil in the samples as a batch.
